name: Polaroid Menu
description: Full-width list menu of titles that reveals a row of thumbnails on hover and, on click, expands into a full-screen grid preview using a GSAP Flip transition.
contents: List of rows, each with a title and a strip of thumbnail images
Full-screen preview layer with large title and image grid per row
behavior: Hovering a row slides in its thumbnails and swaps the title font with a rotating text reveal
Clicking a row covers the screen and flips thumbnails into a grid
Page scrolling is locked while a preview is open
Loader shows until images and fonts are ready
editableByProps: Rows, titles, thumbnail and preview images
Colors, fonts, thumbnail sizes and gaps, preview grid size
Animation durations and stagger, close label

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the pool of sample images

fixed: Locks body scrolling while a preview is open and resets it on unmount
Appends a Google Fonts stylesheet link to document head
Cover and preview layers are fixed to the viewport
Hover interaction has no touch-specific alternative; tapping a row opens the preview
Requires gsap, including the Flip plugin
